theater: 花蓮新城與三棧溪流域

battle.name: 太魯閣之役
battle.theater: 花蓮新城與三棧溪流域
battle.brief: 一八七五年初，福建陸路提督羅大春以代理兵備道身分沿後山北路開闢蘇花古道，屯兵花蓮新城，與太魯閣族在碉堡線上反覆交鋒。清軍以線膛前裝野戰砲的射程壓制峽谷狙擊，番眾退入山嶺，戰事延續至光緒二年，最後以設城與招撫收束。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的一方是大清帝國的臺灣防線。同治十三年牡丹社事件之後，福建巡撫沈葆楨以欽差大臣兼總理臺灣海防的身分入臺，把海防與內治合為一體，兵備道一職由此統轄全臺的調兵、開山與撫番事宜。光緒元年起，代理兵備道的福建陸路提督羅大春主持後山北路，指揮的是駐紮在宜蘭蘇澳至花蓮新城一線的綠營、鎮協各營與募勇，另有受招撫的原住民充任嚮導與挑夫，通事則負責與太魯閣族社的傳話。兵源與糧餉出自福建藩庫，海上運輸沿蘇澳到新城的海岸線，陸上補給靠蘇花古道與溪谷小徑。另一方是太魯閣族，以奇萊、立霧溪與三棧溪流域的各個社為單位行動，獵兵是骨幹，社與社之間靠突擊與聲息相通，既無成建制的砲兵，也沒有攻城用的重砲與大車，只有火繩獵槍、弓矢、標槍與長刀，但熟悉雨林、溪谷與斷崖，可以在自家地盤上任意挑選射擊位置。這場衝突表面是清軍與太魯閣族兩方，實則從一開始就是後山各社之間的連動：光緒元年三月，北路屯營因病減弱，加禮宛一帶的噶瑪蘭族又趁勢煽動七腳川社等南勢阿美族諸社的少壯番蠢動，說明清廷推動的開山政策，遇上的是整個後山山地社會的聯手抵抗，而這一切始終沒有脫離一八七四年日本出兵臺灣之後，清廷以銀錢與允諾換取安撫的那一整套背景。
countriesEn: One side was the Taiwan defence establishment of the Great Qing. After the Mudan Incident of 1874, Shen Baozhen came to the island as imperial commissioner and director-general of Taiwan's coastal defence, merging island defence with civil administration under a single office, the Taiwan Circuit Vice-Commander, which from then on controlled troop movements, road opening and the pacification of the mountain peoples. From 1875 the acting circuit vice-commander, Luo Dachun, the Fujian land forces commander-in-chief, directed the northern route of the eastern hinterland. Under him worked Green Standard troops, battalion and brigade units of the provincial armies, and recruited braves garrisoned along the line from Suao in Yilan to Hualien's Xincheng, together with indigenous men taken into service as guides and porters, while native interpreters carried messages to the Truku villages. Men and money came from the Fujian provincial treasury; stores moved by sea along the coast from Suao to Xincheng and by the Suhua road and creek tracks inland. The other side was the Truku people, acting village by village across the Qilai, Liwu and Sanzhang creek basins. Hunters were the backbone, and villages reached one another by sudden strike and by carried word rather than by any chain of command. They had no formed artillery, no heavy guns for siege work and no wagons, only flintlock hunting guns, bows, spears and long knives, but they knew every ravine and every cliff of the rainforest and could pick their own firing positions anywhere on their own ground. The clash looked like a two-sided fight between Qing troops and the Truku, but from the beginning it was a linked movement among the mountain villages of the eastern hinterland: in the third month of 1875 the northern garrisons were weakened by sickness, and the Kavalan people around the Jialiwan area took the opportunity to egg on the young men of the Seven-Foot Stream village and the southern Amis villages to stir, which shows that the opening-up policy the court was pushing met a combined resistance from the mountain societies of the whole eastern interior. Nor did any of this ever detach from the background: after Japan sent troops to Taiwan in 1874, the Qing court had bought peace with silver and promises.
people: 主腦是羅大春（1833至1890），字景山，貴州施秉人，出身湘軍系的將領，原任福建陸路提督。同治十三年六月他自泉州搭靖遠號輪船抵臺，七月十三日到達蘇澳，七月十七日起代理臺灣兵備道夏獻綸的北臺灣防務與開山撫番事務；隔年一月九日，他的部隊抵達花蓮新城，蘇花古道北路的開闢至此才算告一段落。羅大春在任內沿線建碉堡、興南風澳砲臺，並推動雞籠與滬尾兩座砲臺的興建，留下《臺灣海防並開山日記》與《思痛錄》兩部記錄後山開路的書。他曾親率砲隊攻擊夜襲碉堡的太魯閣族人，把逼近營壘的隊伍擊退；光緒元年八月，他離臺調任湖南提督。上層的推手是沈葆楨，他主持開山撫番，奏准北路、中路、南路同時開山，並在光緒元年二月奏准廢除漢人入山禁令。劉銘傳則以淮軍領袖的身分先任臺灣兵備道，後來出任福建巡撫與首任臺灣巡撫，把開山的說法推到築路、設電報、置縣官與招墾的整套方案。基層的軍官也留名於檔案：陳光華稟報營勇在大清水遭太魯閣狙殺，陳輝煌進紮吳全城並招撫木瓜五社，宣義左營駐紮三層城與三棧。收場時出面斡旋的是新城通事李阿隆；太魯閣方面多以社與番目行動，漢文檔案很少留下可對號的個人姓名。
peopleEn: The man in charge was Luo Dachun (1833-1890), courtesy name Jingshan, a native of Shibing in Guizhou who rose in the Xiang Army system and served as commander-in-chief of the Fujian land forces. In the sixth month of 1873 he left Quanzhou for the island aboard the steamship Jingyuan, reached Suao on the thirteenth of the seventh month, and from the seventeenth of that month acted for Xia Xuanlun, the Taiwan Circuit Vice-Commander, in charge of northern Taiwan's defence and of the campaign to open the mountains and pacify the tribes. On the ninth of the first month of the following year his column reached Xincheng at Hualien, and with that the opening of the northern stretch of the Suhua road could be said to have reached a temporary end. In office he built blockhouses along the line, erected the Nanf'ao battery, and pushed ahead the building of the Keelung and Humen batteries, leaving behind two books that record the opening of the eastern road, the Diary of Taiwan Coastal Defence and Road Opening and the Record of Bitter Reflection. He led his artillery personally against Truku parties that came down on the blockhouses at night and drove off a force that had closed on the barracks; in the eighth month of 1875 he left the island for a post as commander-in-chief in Hunan. The political sponsor above him was Shen Baozhen, who directed the opening-up policy, obtained approval for the northern, central and southern routes to be opened at the same time, and in the second month of 1875 memorialized for the repeal of the ban on Han people entering the mountains. Liu Mingchuan, as a leader of the Huai Army, first held the post of Taiwan Circuit Vice-Commander and later became Fujian governor and the first governor of Taiwan, carrying the idea of opening the mountains into a full programme of roads, telegraphs, county administration and settlement. Officers of the rank and file also appear in the records: Chen Guanghua reported the ambush at Dachingshui in which a military column was picked off; Chen Huihuang moved into Wuancheng and pacified the five Mougua villages; the Xuanyi Left Banner was stationed at Sancheng and at Sanzhang. The man who brokered the end was Li Along, a native interpreter at Xincheng. On the Truku side action was organised by village and by headman, and Chinese-language records rarely preserve personal names that can be matched to individuals.
kits: 卡面這門線膛砲是同治末年清軍野戰與守城的主力。線膛前裝野戰砲的射程與精度都優於舊式滑膛砲，羅大春在後山一線能倚靠的正是這種砲：他在光緒元年正月率砲隊出擊，把趁雨撲向碉堡的太魯閣隊伍壓退。清代這類野戰砲多由外購與福州船政局、江南製造局仿製配發，具體口徑與數量在檔案裡記載不一，多在十餘磅至數十磅之間。它的弱點同樣明顯：前裝砲連同炮車重逾一噸，蘇花古道與三棧溪的谷道只能拆件人抬，牛車拖得上一段便要改由挑夫接力；溪水一漲路就斷，所以出兵只能趕乾季。射擊也慢，每分鐘不過一兩發，洗膛、裝藥、扶正炮架的人手一多，就要抽走一半擔任護衛；而且只有實心球形彈，對厚土木牆與石寨效果有限，仍得靠冷槍與步槍逼近。步兵裝備方面，清軍以冷槍為主，後膛槍已開始少量配發，另有抬槍與火繩槍；太魯閣族用獵前裝槍、弓、標槍與長刀。運輸與後勤靠牛車、挑夫與沿海帆船，糧食以小米、鹽、稻米為主，命令則靠號角、令旗與驛遞傳達。
kitsEn: The gun on the card is the main piece of Qing field and siege ordnance in the late years of the Tongzhi reign. A rifled muzzle-loading field gun outranged and outfired the old smoothbore pieces, and that is exactly what Luo Dachun could rely on in the eastern mountains: in the first month of 1875 he led his artillery out personally and beat back a Truku force that came on the blockhouses in the rain. The Qing obtained guns of this class by purchase and by imitation at the Fuzhou Navy Yard and the Jiangnan Arsenal, and the calibre and number actually issued are recorded inconsistently in the files, mostly somewhere between ten-odd pounds and several dozen pounds. The weaknesses were just as clear. A muzzle-loading gun with its limber weighed well over a ton, and the gorges of the Suhua road and the Sanzhang creek would only carry it in pieces on men's backs, with a cart able to drag it for part of the way before the work passed to porters; when the creeks rose the road was cut, so operations could only be launched in the dry season. Its rate of fire was slow as well, one or two rounds a minute, and the hands needed to swab the barrel, load the charge and right the carriage were so many that half of them had to be taken away to serve as escort. It fired only solid round shot, which told badly against thick earth walls and stone stockades, so cold rifles and muskets still had to close in. On the infantry side the Qing relied on cold rifles, with some breech-loading rifles only beginning to be issued, together with sedan guns and flintlock pieces; the Truku used hunting muzzleloaders, bows, spears and long knives. Transport and supply rested on carts, porters and coastal sailing craft, with millet, salt and rice as the staple loads, while orders travelled by bugle, flag and the mounted relay.
tactics: 清軍的打法是典型的據點式開路。每隔一段路設一座碉堡汛，用牆、壕與射孔把營勇護住，砲隊隨隊駐紮，步槍兵在堡前列陣，專門應付那些伏在兩側林莽裡的狙擊手。羅大春沿後山北路修路時就沿途設堡，使糧隊與援兵不必長途裸露行軍。太魯閣族從不正面進攻，獵兵熟悉每一條溪澗與每一處斷崖，專挑落單的人、掉隊的挑夫與運糧隊下手，遇雨則趁勢撲堡，清廷檔案裡說這類襲擊常常「或數十人、或百人伏途狙擊，乘雨撲碉」，光緒元年四月七日至九日與十二日的兩次襲擊就讓勇丁陣亡十多人。遭到砲火壓制的社眾退入山區，從山上滾下大木與巨石堵塞道路，讓清軍的砲與糧都上不去。光緒元年三月，北路屯駐的兵勇大批病倒，加禮宛一帶的噶瑪蘭族又趁機煽動七腳川社等南勢阿美族諸社的少壯番蠢動，北路兵力愈見單薄。光緒二年羅大春改採攻勢，以優勢砲火壓制三棧溪一帶的番社，番眾避入山嶺，清軍則沿三棧溪畔築順安城作長期據點，用砲火封鎖社寨。最後不是靠殲滅，而是靠通事李阿隆居間斡旋、指名交涉收場。
tacticsEn: The Qing method was opening the road by strongpoint. A blockhouse garrison was set every stretch of the route, with wall, ditch and firing slits to shelter the soldiers inside; the artillery was parked with the column, and riflemen were deployed in front of the fort to answer the sharpshooters lying in the brush on either flank. Luo Dachun had sited blockhouses all along the northern road as he built it, so that supply parties and reinforcements no longer had to march in the open over long distances. The Truku never attacked head-on. Their hunters knew every ravine and every cliff and went specifically for men caught out alone, porters who fell behind and supply columns; when it rained they came on in force, and the Qing files describe such attacks as coming on in numbers of dozens or a hundred, ambushing along the road and falling on the fort in the rain. The raids of the seventh to ninth and the twelfth of the fourth month of 1875 cost the garrison more than ten men dead. Communities pressed by gunfire withdrew up the mountain and rolled great trees and boulders down to block the road, so that neither the guns nor the food could be carried up. In the third month of 1875 many of the soldiers stationed on the northern road fell ill, and the Kavalan people around the Jialiwan area used the opening to egg the young men of the Seven-Foot Stream village and the southern Amis villages into stirring, so that the northern line grew thinner still. In 1876 Luo Dachun changed to the offensive, using superior gunfire to bear on the villages around the Sanzhang creek. The villagers took refuge higher up the mountain while the Qing built the Shunan fortress on the bank of the Sanzhang creek as a permanent base and sealed the villages with artillery fire. The affair did not end by annihilation but through the native interpreter Li Along, who brokered a negotiated submission with the leaders named one by one.
data: 可核的數字大致如下。光緒元年一月九日羅大春部隊抵達花蓮新城，同月十日營勇通過大清水時即遭太魯閣狙殺；二十四至二十六日與二月五日至八日，砲隊兩度出動攻擊來襲者。四月七日至九日及十二日又有襲擊，勇丁陣亡十多人。光緒元年二月，沈葆楨奏准廢除漢人入山禁令。往前推算：同治十三年五月日本出兵臺灣，陸上兵員三千六百五十八人、軍艦乘員七百三十四人，日軍戰死十二人、病死五百六十一人；牡丹社等社的參戰人數可能約六百人，戰死至少二十餘人、負傷五十餘人。同治十三年十月，李鴻章奏准淮軍十三營六千五百人分批赴臺。議和的結果是五十萬兩銀，拆作撫恤十萬兩與購買道路房屋四十萬兩。地理上，羅大春開的路自蘇澳東澳到奇萊，即今花蓮港北岸附近；他在一八七四年八月一日於蘇澳大南澳所立的開路紀念碑，高二百零七公分、厚十四公分、寬六十一公分。大南澳一帶原有十三個泰雅族社，直到清廷設哨屯墾之後才逐漸與內地打通。光緒元年八月，羅大春離臺調任湖南提督。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. On the ninth of the first month of 1875 Luo Dachun's column reached Xincheng at Hualien, and on the tenth of that same month a military party crossing the Dachingshui was picked off by Truku shooters; on the twenty-fourth to twenty-sixth and again on the fifth to eighth of the second month the artillery moved out twice against the attackers. Further raids on the seventh to ninth and the twelfth of the fourth month cost the garrison more than ten dead. In the second month of 1875 Shen Baozhen obtained approval for the ban on Han entry into the mountains to be lifted. Looking further back: in the fifth month of 1873 Japan sent troops to Taiwan, with three thousand six hundred and fifty-eight men ashore and seven hundred and thirty-four men in the squadron; the Japanese lost twelve killed and five hundred and sixty-one dead of disease, while the participating villages, Mudan and others, may have numbered around six hundred men, with at least twenty-odd killed and more than fifty wounded. In the tenth month of that year Li Hongzhang obtained approval for thirteen Huai Army battalions, six thousand five hundred strong, to sail to Taiwan in batches. The settlement came to five hundred thousand taels of silver, split into one hundred thousand in compensation and four hundred thousand for the purchase of roads and buildings. Geographically, the road Luo Dachun opened ran from Dong'ao at Suao to Qilai, near the north shore of today's Hualien harbour; the monument he raised at Dannan'ao in Suao on the first of August 1874 measures two hundred and seven centimetres high, fourteen thick and sixty-one wide. The Dannan'ao area held thirteen Atayal villages, and it was only after the Qing set up posts and settlement that the area was gradually linked to the settled districts. In the eighth month of 1875 Luo Dachun left the island for a post as commander-in-chief in Hunan.
cause: 這場衝突是清廷自己的開山政策撞上太魯閣族領域的結果。一八七一年琉球漁民在臺灣南部遇害並遭殺害，引發八瑤灣事件；日本以此為由在一八七四年五月出兵臺灣南部，攻擊牡丹社、高士佛社與射不力社。清廷在淡水議和之後，以五十萬兩換取日本撤兵，並且答應懲辦番社，日本的行動因此被認定為保民義舉，東部邊防的問題從此擺上桌面。為免東部再度落入外力之手，沈葆楨提出開山撫番，奏准北路、中路、南路同時開闢，其中北路自蘇澳東澳經奇萊直抵花蓮，並在光緒元年二月奏准廢除漢人入山禁令，讓漢人得以入山墾殖。官方的算盤是修路、建堡、屯墾，再以收撫把各社納入版籍。直接導火線則在後山北路一線：一八七四年秋路隊與營勇進入太魯閣族世代活動的奇萊、立霧與三棧溪一帶修路、設哨、屯墾，逼近社寨，獵場被開成道路，於是光緒元年正月起，太魯閣各社開始夜襲碉堡、狙殺營勇，把清軍逼到只能以碉堡自保的位置上。
causeEn: The clash was the result of the court's own opening-up policy colliding with Truku territory. In 1871 Ryukyuan fishermen met their deaths in southern Taiwan, which produced the Amoy incident of that year; Japan used it as a pretext to send troops into southern Taiwan in May 1874 and to attack the villages of Mudan, Gaosifu and Shebuli. After the negotiations at Tamsui the Qing court bought the withdrawal of the Japanese troops for five hundred thousand taels and gave a promise that the villages would be punished, so that the Japanese action was recognised as a righteous act to protect the people, and the question of the eastern frontier was henceforth put on the table. Fearing that the east might again fall to a foreign power, Shen Baozhen proposed to open the mountains and pacify the tribes, obtaining approval for the northern, central and southern routes to be opened together, the northern one running from Dong'ao at Suao through Qilai to Hualien, and in the second month of 1875 he secured the repeal of the ban on Han entry so that Han settlers could go in and cultivate. The court's calculation was to build roads and blockhouses, to garrison and settle, and then to bring the villages into the register through negotiated submission. The immediate spark lay on the northern road itself: in the autumn of 1874 road parties and military columns entered the Qilai, Liwu and Sanzhang creek country where the Truku had hunted for generations, and began to build roads, set posts and farm there, closing on the villages and turning hunting grounds into trackways. From the first month of 1875 the Truku villages began raiding the blockhouses by night and picking off soldiers, pushing the Qing troops back into a position where nothing but the blockhouses held them.
impact: 這場戰役是清廷在臺灣東部第一次用成建制武力推動開山，後果既是打開了路，也是打散了原有的部落空間。蘇花古道北段自蘇澳到新城是官修道路中最早的一段，日治時期改建成蘇花公路，後來北迴線的蘇花段便由此而來；清廷在東部設縣、設撫墾局、招漢人墾戶的整套政策，也是在這條路打通之後才有條件推動。但開了路不等於站得住腳：北路的汛地只駐兵不實墾，幾年後就撤守廢棄，直到日治時期一九一四年的太魯閣戰爭與其後大南澳十三社歸順，東部才算真正連通。戰役同時確立的處置模式影響更久：以砲火與據點壓住局面，再以通事斡旋、拿辦首惡、賞撫收社作結，此後清廷對山區各族的剿撫並用大致照此辦理。對太魯閣族而言，代價是社域被道路與汛地切開，獵場與耕地逐步流失，族群被迫向更高更狹的山區退。對清軍而言，最大的弱點也被暴露：冷槍數量有限、糧秣靠海運再挑入山、溪水一漲即斷糧，後山這種補給結構，任何一次持久戰都會把部隊拖垮。
impactEn: The campaign was the first time the Qing court pushed the opening of the mountains in eastern Taiwan with formed troops, and the result was as much a breaking up of the old village space as an opening of the road. The northern stretch of the Suhua road from Suao to Xincheng was the earliest section built by the government, was rebuilt as the Suhua highway under Japanese rule, and the later Suao section of the North-Link Line grew out of it; the whole package of county administration, reclamation bureaus and Han settlement in the east could only be pushed forward once the road was through. But an opened road is not a held road. The garrisons on the northern route held men without settling the land, and were withdrawn and abandoned within a few years, and the east was not truly connected until the Truku War of 1914 under Japanese rule and the subsequent submission of the thirteen Dannan'ao villages. The pattern of handling the affair also outlived it: hold the situation with gunfire and strongpoints, then end it through an interpreter, the seizure of the ringleaders and the granting of amnesty, which was broadly the way the Qing thereafter combined pursuit and negotiation in the mountains. For the Truku the cost was a homeland cut open by roads and garrisons, with hunting grounds and farmland slipping away and the people driven higher and deeper into the ranges. For the Qing troops the campaign exposed the gravest weakness of all: limited numbers of cold rifles, supplies carried by sea and then on men's backs, and grain cut off the moment the creeks rose. A supply structure like that in the eastern mountains would break any army in a long war.
result: 光緒元年正月至二月，太魯閣族人連番夜襲新城一帶的碉堡，羅大春親率砲隊出擊，兩度把逼近營壘的隊伍擊退；此後他改以守點為主，宣義左營駐紮三層城與三棧，陳輝煌進紮吳全城並招撫木瓜五社，把推進速度壓下來。四月七日至九日及十二日的襲擊仍造成勇丁陣亡十多人，北路屯營同時因疫病有病倒者，反映後山補給與醫藥的不足。光緒二年，羅大春以優勢砲火討伐尤仔丹溪，也就是今日三棧溪一帶的番社，番眾退上高山，從山頂滾下大木與巨石抵禦；清軍則沿三棧溪畔設順安城，把攻勢變成長期封鎖。最後由新城通事李阿隆居間斡旋乞和，羅大春命其搜捕三名首惡送往臺北，征討至此收束。結果是清軍以砲火換到道路與社的招撫，卻沒有換到實墾：北路汛地隔年隨羅大春離臺而撤，開山政策在東部第一次大規模用兵，得到的只是一紙和約與幾座空堡，太魯閣族退回深山，清廷的後山治理又等了半個世紀才重新開始。
resultEn: In the first and second months of 1875 the Truku made repeated night attacks on the blockhouses around Xincheng, and Luo Dachun went out with his artillery personally, twice beating off a force that had closed on the barracks. He then changed to a defensive footing: the Xuanyi Left Banner was stationed at Sancheng and Sanzhang, Chen Huihuang moved into Wuancheng and pacified the five Mougua villages, and the rate of advance was deliberately slowed. The raids of the seventh to ninth and the twelfth of the fourth month still cost more than ten of the garrison dead, while sickness was taking men off the northern line at the same time, which showed how thin were supply and medical care in the eastern mountains. In 1876 Luo Dachun turned to the offensive and used his superior gunfire against the villages around Youzhidanxi, that is around today's Sanzhang creek; the villagers withdrew high up the mountain and rolled great trees and boulders down on the attackers, while the Qing built the Shunan fortress on the bank of the creek and turned the assault into a long blockade. The matter was closed at last by Li Along, the native interpreter at Xincheng, who brokered a negotiated peace, on Luo Dachun's order that he search out and seize three ringleaders and send them to Taipei. The upshot was that the Qing exchanged gunfire for a road and for the submission of the villages, but not for settlement: the northern garrisons were withdrawn the following year when Luo Dachun left the island, and the first large-scale use of troops by the opening-up policy in the east produced only a negotiated peace and a few empty blockhouses. The Truku withdrew into the high mountains, and the Qing would have to wait half a century before it began to govern the eastern hinterland in earnest.
